meta.name: competitor-research
meta.description: Research competitor products, launch history, and acquisition evidence from public sources or supplied materials. Use when evaluating growth claims, comparing competitors, or choosing growth experiments. Produces a cited brief that separates observations, attributed claims, estimates, and hypotheses.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 梳理竞品发布历史与增长证据,产出带出处的调研简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正评估对手的增长数据、要决定下一个增长实验怎么押
copy.tagline_en: Turn competitor launch history and growth evidence into a cited brief
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're weighing rival growth claims and picking your next experiment

howto.what: 它会从公开网页或你提供的材料里调研竞品的产品、发布历史和获客证据,产出一份带引用的简报,并把观察到的事实、来源声明、估算和假设分开标注。
howto.when: 当你要评估增长说法、对比竞品或挑选增长实验时触发;也可直接点名让它调研某个竞品网址。

say.text: 用 competitor-research 调研这个竞品网址:https://…
把竞品的安装量和付费用户分开标注,别混为一谈。
say.note: 按证据类型分别下结论

say.text: 给我三个两周内、预算 100 美元能跑的增长实验。
say.note: 每条含观测→假设→小测试

howto.what_en: It researches a competitor's product, launch history, and acquisition evidence from public sources or your supplied materials, then produces a cited brief that separates observed facts, attributed claims, estimates, and hypotheses.
howto.when_en: Use it when you evaluate growth claims, compare competitors, or pick growth experiments; you can also point it at a specific competitor URL.

say_en.text: Use competitor-research on this competitor URL: https://…
Keep installs and paid users separate in the competitor numbers.
Suggest three growth tests I can run in two weeks for $100.
